guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for ASE atoms properties by analyzing info and calculator results from a list of atoms
guess_target_metadata: guess target metadata including shape, type, and extensiveness from atom lengths and target samples
check_target_extensive: check whether a target property is extensive or intensive by analyzing per-atom normalized variation
check_target_per_atom: check whether a target is per-atom by verifying the first dimension matches atom count
check_uniform_atoms_lengths: check whether all structures in a dataset have the same number of atoms
